title: Answer: life is not required for consciousness

statements.text: The view has no theory of life. It holds that life is not required for consciousness: the living, self-maintaining features of organisms matter only through the computations they support, and a requirement of specific material composition is set aside as incompatible with the view.

sources.quote: The proposal that consciousness depends on material composition is clearly incompatible with computational functionalism, so we can set it aside.
